explanation: This theorem says that the library's Hecke ring homomorphism `heckeRingHomCharSpace` sends the generator `heckeTGeneratorGamma0 N p` to the restriction of the library's operator `heckeTNat k p`. Every object in the statement is defined in the library itself, and the proof is just `LinearMap.ext` plus `Subtype.ext` applied to the library's own lemma `coe_heckeRingHomCharSpace_heckeTGeneratorGamma0`. I grepped Mathlib for `heckeRing`, `HeckeRing` and `heckeT`. The only match is `Mathlib/NumberTheory/HeckeRing/Defs.lean`, which defines Hecke triples and cosets in general. It has nothing on Hecke operators acting on modular forms or on spaces of forms with a character, so I found no Mathlib declaration with this content.
